test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following is/are useful effort(s) for sustainability of resources?

a. Switching off unnecessary lights and fans

b. Using lift instead of stairs

c. Repairing leaking taps for conserving water

d. Using empty containers to store things

e. Going to school by your own car instead of cycling
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 3) a, c and d**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__****Efforts for Sustainability of Resources:**

 
• **Switching off unnecessary lights and fans:** This helps in conserving electricity, which is a crucial resource. By reducing the consumption of electricity, we are helping in the reduction of fossil fuel
